sites.name: Cai Rang Floating Market
sites.event: A national intangible cultural heritage, the most typical cultural feature of the Western river region, where goods are traded on the river.

place.commune: Le Binh Ward (and neighboring wards on the Can Tho River)

sites.name: Binh Thuy Ancient House
sites.event: An ancient house over 150 years old with a unique blend of East-West architecture, which was once the setting for the famous movie 'The Lover' (L'Amant).

sites.name: Ninh Kieu Wharf
sites.event: The symbol of Can Tho City, associated with anecdotes and poetry, the intersection of the Hau River and the Can Tho River.

sites.name: Binh Thuy Communal House (Long Tuyen Co Mieu)
sites.event: A national-level artistic architectural relic, one of the most beautiful and intact ancient communal houses in the Southwestern region.

sites.name: Bang Lang Stork Sanctuary
sites.event: The largest bird sanctuary in the Mekong Delta, gathering thousands of storks and rare bird species.

sites.name: Truc Lam Phuong Nam Zen Monastery
sites.event: The largest Zen monastery in the Southwestern region, deeply imbued with the cultural architecture of the Ly - Tran dynasties.

sites.name: Ong Temple (Quang Trieu Assembly Hall)
sites.event: A national artistic architectural relic, a typical Chinese temple with brilliant and sacred architecture.

sites.name: Bui Huu Nghia Valedictorian Tomb Relic Site
sites.event: The resting and memorial place of cultural celebrity Bui Huu Nghia - one of the 'Golden Dragons' of the ancient Dong Nai land.

sites.name: Can Tho Grand Prison
sites.event: A prison built by the French colonialists in 1886, which detained many revolutionary soldiers and patriotic compatriots.

sites.name: Son Islet
sites.event: A famous community-based ecotourism destination with the model of raising flying snakehead fish and fruit orchards.

sites.name: Phong Dien Floating Market
sites.event: A floating market that still retains the wild and rustic features of the orchard river culture.

sites.name: Gian Gua (Gian Gua Historical Relic)
sites.event: A city-level historical relic, famous for its giant ancient Gua tree with intertwined branches forming a large trellis, which was once a revolutionary base.
